headline: The board itself was the bug: it ranked already-shipped work as top priority, and a [skip ci] cron had armed an invisible e2e failure.

items.title: Stale-open-task gate now verifies artifact evidence, not prose similarity
items.insight: S281's own genius list ranked two S280-shipped items as top priorities. Two blind spots: a ticked [x] only counted as done if the prose ALSO said 'DONE S{N}' (S280's never did), and title-jaccard@0.8 scored 'Commit a snapshot' vs 'Committed snapshot + wiring' at only ~0.38 because jaccard punishes size asymmetry. Fix: the checkbox IS the done state (candidate pool 8->24, zero new false positives) plus an orthogonal artifact-evidence detector asking whether the named deliverable exists NOW. Prose-similarity was measured on the live corpus and rejected at a 50% false-positive rate; the evidence detector scores 2/2 true positives and 0/49 false positives.

items.title: Not every [x] is evidence the work happened
items.insight: Consolidating three duplicate 'Homepage LCP' records instantly produced a 100%-overlap false positive: the gate began reporting the surviving, genuinely-open, founder-gated carry as done — the exact lie the session was fixing, self-inflicted in one edit, caught only by re-running the gate. Modelled two kinds of [x]: a work-done closure (valid evidence) versus a record-consolidation closure (closes a duplicate record; the work lives on). Self-test pins that the exclusion is marker-driven, not title-driven.

items.title: Defused an armed e2e failure: byte-equality is only valid when every input is reproducible
items.insight: build-geo-vitals --check byte-compared api/geo-vitals.json against .cache/probe-colo-supplement.ndjson, an Actions-cache-only input uptime-probe.yml deliberately never commits. Cron commit c7db58811 landed supplement-derived rows under [skip ci], so CI never ran on it — guaranteeing an e2e.yml build:check failure on the next ordinary push. Proved on a pristine origin/main worktree (exit 1). Now enforces structural + privacy invariants always (no country below minSamples=3 may ever be named) and byte-compares only when the supplement is present. Verified to flip all three ways, including still catching injected drift. Sweep: 1/62 byte-comparing gates affected; class contained.

items.title: Gates must enumerate git-tracked files, never walk the filesystem
items.insight: check-orphan-scripts used fs.readdirSync, judging files CI can never check out — hard-failing build:check locally on every run while every CI run stayed green. Now enumerates git ls-files, filtered to genuine top-level: an unfiltered git pathspec crosses directory boundaries and silently annexed scripts/lib (352->395), which check-orphan-libs owns. Correct subject set 351 = 352 - 1. Verified the gate still catches a tracked orphan.

items.title: Cleared a CANON-019 phantom-blocker and 16 duplicate records with zero information lost
items.insight: The [S187] wishlist item still claimed 'Supabase admin MISSING' after S280 corrected the newer duplicate — re-verified READY 2/2, while the founder queue still rendered 'Requires missing credential'. Correcting a premise is not done until every duplicate carrying it is swept. Hand-consolidated one-job-many-records rot (TT-ENFORCE x5, RICHER-IGNIS x3, Homepage LCP x3, Social Dashboard x3, 2 founder-action pairs): 49->33 open tasks, NOW from 4 items (2 phantom) to 1.

followUps: Confirm the S281 push went green — it is the first non-[skip ci] push since the cron armed the geo-vitals e2e failure, so a green e2e run is the proof of the defusal.

Founder call: something keeps recreating scripts/fetch-studio-feed.mjs (deleted S275, re-killed S279, back again with a one-line diff). Not deleted — it differs from every committed version, so deleting an untracked file would destroy unrecoverable work.
Candidate: have the uptime cron run affected --check gates before committing, so a [skip ci] commit cannot hand a broken tree to the next human push.
Candidate: date-normalise --check comparisons in date-embedding generators (build-agents-json drifted purely because this session crossed 00:00Z).
blockers: Worker deploy provider token lacks Workers R2 Storage:Edit + User Details:Read + Memberships:Read for vaultspark-rum (re-verified S276 via /user 403 — genuinely founder-gated, needs CF dashboard token-minting).
honestDeferrals: Automated duplicate-open clustering gate NOT shipped (D-S281.4): probed at thresholds 0.6/0.7/0.8/0.9, it both missed the real duplicates (Homepage LCP titles diverge on parentheticals; TT's bare titles carry too few tokens) and invented false clusters (union-find transitivity chained 'Add Workers KV scopes' to 'Revoke compromised PAT'). Its one surviving post-cleanup finding is itself that false positive.

Speculative meta-gate for the geo-vitals class NOT shipped (D-S281.5): the sweep found 1/62 (now fixed) and its other 5 candidates were false positives of its own heuristic — a self-test fixture string, and gates already degrading gracefully (each verified exit 0 with inputs absent).
